title: llama.cpp CUDA b9637 for Kaggle T4
subtitle: Offline llama-server b9637 for CUDA 12.8 and Tesla T4
description: Static llama-server runtime used by the Bengali hallucination Phase 2 inference notebook. Built from ggml-org/llama.cpp release b9637, commit aedb2a5e9ca3d4064148bbb919e0ddc0c1b70ab3, with CUDA enabled for compute capability 7.5.
